faq.heading: FAQ
faq.subheading: Common questions about security and privacy
faq.safeQ: Is it safe to connect my Telegram?
faq.safeA: Yes. Your account connects via QR code — the same flow Telegram Web and Desktop use, so you stay in control. Read-only tools work out of the box. Write tools (send a reply, react, save a draft) are available so the AI can act on your behalf when you ask it to. Irreversible actions (delete, edit, kick) are off by default and require an explicit opt-in in your settings, with a daily quota and an audit log. You can disconnect or revoke the session at any time from Telegram → Settings → Devices.
faq.readQ: Can you read my messages on the server?
faq.readAStart: We don't store your messages. Each tool call fetches data directly from Telegram's API and returns it to the AI assistant. Your Telegram session key is stored on our server so the connector can keep working between requests, and is deleted whenever your session ends (see the next answer for the exact timing). Storage details and hardening guidance are in our
faq.protocolQ: How does it connect without the Bot API?
faq.protocolA: It uses MTProto — the same protocol Telegram's official apps use. You authenticate via QR code, just like linking a new device. From Telegram's perspective, it's another logged-in client.
faq.disconnectA: If you explicitly remove the connector in Claude.ai or ChatGPT, the server logs the Telegram session out and deletes the session key right away. If you just close the AI app without revoking, the in-memory client is dropped immediately and the stored session key is kept briefly so you can resume seamlessly; if you don't reconnect within a short idle window (a few minutes), the server logs out and deletes the key automatically. You can also force a full revoke at any time from Telegram → Settings → Devices.
faq.chatgptAStart: Yes. Add it as an app in ChatGPT Settings → Apps (Developer Mode). Use the URL
faq.chatgptAEnd: with OAuth authentication. Works on Plus, Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans.

faq.botAEnd: to get notified about service status, breaking changes and new releases. Send /stop any time to unsubscribe.

examplesPage.metaTitle: Examples — What people ask Claude AI & ChatGPT about Telegram
examplesPage.metaDescription: 12 ready-to-use prompts for Claude AI and ChatGPT to read your Telegram chats: morning briefings, finding messages, extracting data, people lookup, and more.
examplesPage.heading: Real-world examples
examplesPage.subheading: Twelve ready-to-paste prompts. Each one works after connecting Telegram via Quickstart.

morning.title: Morning briefing
morning.description: A daily summary of unread chats, with urgent items pulled to the top.
morning.prompt: Summarize my unread Telegram messages from the last 12 hours. Group them by chat, highlight anything that mentions "urgent", "deadline", or a date in the next 48 hours, and list any direct questions addressed to me.

weeklyDigest.title: Weekly digest from a busy channel
weeklyDigest.description: Catch up on a noisy channel without scrolling through hundreds of posts.
weeklyDigest.prompt: Look at the last 7 days of messages in my "AI News" Telegram channel. Give me 5 bullet points of the most-discussed topics, with one example link per topic.

findDeadline.title: Find that deadline message
findDeadline.description: Locate a specific past message without remembering the exact words.
findDeadline.prompt: Find the message in our work chat where someone mentioned the project deadline. Show me the date, who sent it, and 2 messages of context before and after.

findFiles.title: Find shared documents
findFiles.description: List every file someone shared in a chat over a date range.
findFiles.prompt: Show me all PDF and DOCX attachments shared in the "Design Team" Telegram chat in the last 30 days, sorted newest first, with the file name and who sent it.

linksThisWeek.title: All links shared this week
linksThisWeek.description: Build a reading list from links your community shared.
linksThisWeek.prompt: List every URL shared in the "Reading Group" Telegram channel this week. Deduplicate, group by domain, and add the message timestamp for each.

extractActions.title: Extract action items
extractActions.description: Turn an informal chat thread into a TODO list.
extractActions.prompt: Read the last 50 messages in my team chat and extract any action items. For each action, include the assignee, the deadline if mentioned, and a one-line description.

topMembers.title: Most active community members
topMembers.description: Spot helpers and leaders in a community group.
topMembers.prompt: In our community Telegram group, list the top 10 most active members of the last 30 days. For each, show how many messages they sent and one representative recent message.

whoMentioned.title: Who mentioned me
whoMentioned.description: Find messages that addressed you directly.
whoMentioned.prompt: Show me all messages from the last 7 days where someone mentioned me by @username or replied directly to one of my messages. Group by chat.

chatActivity.title: Chat activity over time
chatActivity.description: See when a chat is busy and quiet.
chatActivity.prompt: For my "Engineering Team" chat, show message counts per day for the last 14 days. Tell me which days had unusual spikes or silences.

unreadByChat.title: Unread by chat
unreadByChat.description: Triage your inbox with one prompt.
unreadByChat.prompt: List all my Telegram chats that have unread messages right now, sorted by unread count descending. For each, show the chat name and the first 3 unread messages.

photosFamily.title: Recent family photos
photosFamily.description: Pull recent shared photos and view them inline.
photosFamily.prompt: Show me the photos sent in the "Family" Telegram chat in the last 3 days. Display them inline with the date and who sent each photo.

voiceTranscripts.title: Transcripts of voice messages
voiceTranscripts.description: Skim long voice notes by reading them as text.
voiceTranscripts.prompt: Find all voice messages sent in my "Coworking" group chat this week. Transcribe each one and present them as a chronological list with sender and timestamp.

quickstart.metaTitle: Quickstart — Connect Telegram to Claude AI or ChatGPT
quickstart.metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to connect your Telegram account to Claude AI or ChatGPT in 30 seconds. QR-code login, no API keys.
quickstart.heading: Quickstart
quickstart.subheading: Connect your Telegram in under a minute. Pick your AI assistant below.
quickstart.tabClaudeDesc: Add the connector in claude.ai · 5 steps · ~30 seconds
quickstart.tabChatGPTDesc: Add as an app in ChatGPT · 3 steps · Plus, Pro, Team, Enterprise
quickstart.needAccount: You'll need a Telegram account on your phone with a recent Telegram client (so the QR-login option is available).
quickstart.claudeMetaDescription: Connect Telegram to Claude.ai in 5 steps via the Connectors menu. Read messages, search chats, get contacts.
quickstart.claudeIntro: Five steps. About thirty seconds. No API keys.
quickstart.claudeStep1Desc: Sign in to claude.ai and open Settings. Free, Pro, Max, and Team plans all support connectors.
quickstart.claudeStep2Desc: In Settings, find the Connectors section and click "Add custom connector".
quickstart.claudeStep3Desc: Enter the URL below in the connector dialog and click Connect.
quickstart.claudeStep4Desc: Claude.ai redirects to our OAuth consent screen. Click Approve, then a QR code appears. Open Telegram → Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device → scan the QR.
quickstart.claudeStep5Desc: Claude.ai redirects back; you'll see a green "Connected" status. Ask it to read your chats: "Summarize my unread messages" works as a first prompt.
quickstart.claudeTroubleshootQRTitle: QR code expired or didn't scan
quickstart.claudeTroubleshootQRDesc: QR codes are valid for ~30 seconds. Refresh the connector dialog and try again. Make sure your phone has internet access while scanning.
quickstart.claudeTroubleshootDisconnectedDesc: Open the connector in Claude.ai and click Reconnect — you'll get a new QR. Sessions can also be revoked from Telegram → Settings → Devices.
quickstart.claudeTroubleshootChatsDesc: If Claude says you have no chats, your Telegram session likely needs reactivation. Disconnect and reconnect from claude.ai → Settings → Connectors.
quickstart.chatgptMetaDescription: Connect Telegram to ChatGPT in 3 steps via Apps Directory. Plus, Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans supported.
quickstart.chatgptIntro: Three steps. ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Team, or Enterprise required (Apps feature).
quickstart.chatgptStep1Desc: In ChatGPT Settings → Connectors → Advanced, toggle on Developer Mode. This lets you add custom MCP apps.
quickstart.chatgptStep2Desc: In Settings → Connectors → Create, choose I trust this application, paste the URL below, and click Create.
quickstart.chatgptStep3Desc: ChatGPT redirects to our OAuth screen. Approve, then scan the QR with Telegram → Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device. ChatGPT redirects back and the app is ready.
quickstart.chatgptTroubleshootDoubleQRDesc: ChatGPT sometimes opens two parallel OAuth flows on first connect. Scan either QR — the second flow auto-redirects to the first session. Closing the duplicate tab is fine.
quickstart.chatgptTroubleshootLinkNotFoundDesc: ChatGPT doesn't auto-reconnect after server restarts. Disconnect and reconnect the app in ChatGPT Settings → Apps to re-establish the SSE stream.
